reviews.text: New puppy - first visit to the Dr.  Bringing the cat next.  The team at Kearny Mesa is great.  You can tell they love their work 💕

I’ve been brining my dog and cat here for years and the team is great. They are friendly, take good care of their patients, have designated parking, and their pricing is reasonable. I’ll continue being a client- thank you!!
Took my cat there, staff is very nice! We got back the results of her bloodwork the next day!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

Hi Leah, thank you for taking the time to leave us a rating. We pride ourselves on providing the best care, and we're disappointed you did not have a great experience with us. We'd love to know where we fell short. Please contact us at (858) 279-3000 if you have any additional feedback. We hope, if ever needed, you trust us to take care of you and your pet.

I brought my dog, Chachi, to Kearny Mesa Veterinary when he suddenly developed issues with his hind legs and was unable to walk. After evaluation, it was determined that he had IVDD, and the entire team was incredibly supportive throughout this difficult experience.

Dr. Maria Martinez and the staff showed genuine compassion, empathy, and concern for both Chachi and me every step of the way. I especially appreciated their quick response times whenever I had questions or concerns, as well as the helpful guidance they provided for managing his condition and recovery.

One feature I found particularly valuable was their text support line. It made it easy to get assistance with medications, ask questions, and receive advice on caring for Chachi at home. The communication was excellent and gave me peace of mind during a stressful time.

I also found their pricing to be fair and reasonable. At no point did I feel pressured into unnecessary tests, treatments, or services. Their focus was always on providing the care Chachi actually needed.

I am very grateful to Dr.Maria Martinez and the entire team at Kearny Mesa Veterinary for their professionalism, kindness, and dedication. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate and trustworthy veterinary care.❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹

I brought my cat, Tomasa, here who has been struggling with allergies for months. We had been taking her to Tijuana for treatment, and while her allergies and scabs were improving, they never fully healed. I decided to try Kearny Mesa Veterinary Center and I'm so glad I did.

The first person who greeted us was Sara, who was sweet and welcoming. She let us know we could be seen earlier than expected, which immediately helped ease my anxiety.

Next, we met Christina, who was funny, kind, and wonderful with Tomasa. She made us feel comfortable and helped make the visit a positive experience.

Dr. Marissa Robertson was absolutely fantastic. She took the time to listen to our concerns and carefully reviewed all the different foods we had tried feeding Tomasa. She explained how allergies work in cats in a way that was easy to understand and reassured us that we were doing everything we could as pet parents.

For the first time in months, we felt truly heard and left with a clear plan. Best of all, Tomasa has been doing great since her appointment. We're already looking forward to her follow-up visit.

Free parking is available, but limited. The clinic is very spacious and clean.
I definitely recommend this vet office. They are kind, supportive, and communicate well. There are no surprises for services, yeah!
Always kind and patient, love this vet!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

I just established care here with my kitty! I was pleasantly surprised with the kindness that radiates from the entire office. Dr. Robertson made my anxious kitty feel safe, while explaining my pets immediate needs,  and helped me set a plan for more routine care. the vet technician was able to give me a great price breakdown so i really understood what i was paying for, and got me scheduled for a follow up that best fit my schedule. I left feeling better educated instead of guilty about how to keep my pet healthy and happy. Excellent place to take your pets, will be telling all my friends!

I have been bring my dog Maui here for the past 3 years.
Place was recently remodeled. Has comfortable parking and staff is always friendly.
They are usually pretty good to get me appts even with short notice.
Maui’s Vet is Dr Martinez and she is great! She has even done his deep teeth cleaning and everything ran smoothly.
I have had positive experience here at the vet.
Came in because my cat was sick and to establish a primary vet. They were great- explained all my options and took good care of my cat. He's already feeling better the next day.
Wonderful team, best vet I’ve been to
Amazing service!  We love it here. The vet tech Leslie is amazing as well.
My cat was very calm during the visit and even laid comfortably on the scale with her paws tucked under the whole time. Our questions were answered fully. I will be bringing my other cat in as well.

October 2025: This review is long overdue!  Shout out to Dr. Diego for seeing my dog last minute back in October 2025 when he had a dislocated dew claw accident.  I was able to get Trazadone a couple of hours from the vet office before seeing Dr. Diego, which really helped alleviate the anxiety my dog was experiencing.  I also appreciate how Dr. Diego was not pushy about certain interventions or medications I did not have the budget to pay for.  Lastly, shout out to Leslie who was the nurse who took care of my dog.  She was very kind, professional, and compassionate toward my dog.  All of the front desk ladies are also very kind and professional.  You all rock!

Shout out to Erin who treated dog Moka with so much compassion as he struggles with social anxiety.  So awesome!

Warm and caring to my pooch.
They took great care of my cat Judy.

After explaining what were my dog symptoms, I was given a very expensive list of procedures to follow. The list amounted to close to a thousand dollars. I explained that I have a very limited budget but was told that those were the exams needed when in fact the vet could have advised me to start with allergy pills and see if that worked and then, if it didn't, to proceed with the next test, etc.
I was also told that the x rays would be over $300 but that no vet there is a radiologist and therefore it would be another $250 to have them read elsewhere.
They presented me with another blood work procedure that would also be over $350 and charge me extra for disposing "medical waste" meaning the syringe used for drawing blood. Even after I declined, asking the vet if we could just start with the x rays and take it from there, I was given allergy pills that were over $100, when perhaps knowing my budget was very limited, they could have started me with Benadryl and see how my dog reacted.

I paid my bill in cash, over $500!! Only to realize they charged me for the medical waste disposal!!! When no blood work had been done. When I asked for a refund, I was told they could only credit me the money for my next visit, and did not give me cash back, even though I had just paid cash.

To add insult to injury, I when I asked to please send me an email with my paid bill and the credit showing, as well as a copy of the $300 x-rays, I was told they would email it to me. To this day, three days later, I have not received the x-rays, the invoice with the credit showing and also no call from the vet to see how my dog is doing.

I hope to receive my bill with the x rays and credit showing by the beginning of the week. Otherwise, I feel like I should post my review in public.

It is outrageous to me that after explaining my very difficult financial status, that exams were over $1000 right off the bat instead of just suggesting as a first course of treatment an inexpensive and perhaps efficient course of allergy pills!

I am considering looking for another veterinarian for my dogs

Second review:

I went back on Monday to talk to them and hoped for a resolution. The receptionist was open to listening to me and told me she was willing to send me a link of where I could download the x-rays in zip form. It was the only way they could share with me.

I asked if I could get my money back from the pills, as they turned out to be pills that treated allergy itching and not for coughing. At first I was told they could not refund me the money because those pills were given as a possible treatment and I had agreed to take them with me. I explained that I had taken them because I was not the professional and I had trusted my vet to give me the right treatment but another vet I saw afterwards told me those pills were not meant to treat coughing, only itching, and that was why I wanted a refund. I said I felt confident enough they were the wrong pills that I was willing to take it to court.

The receptionist was nice enough to go ask the manager again for a refund and they decided to refund me for the pills I brought back that I had not used. They also refunded me the medical waste fee that had been incorrectly charged the first time.

After checking my email account to see if the email with the x-ray link had been mailed to me, we doubled checked and they had my email wrong, so the receptionist was kind enough to correct it and resend me the email.

I was very grateful that she was helpful to me and that she understood my situation and was willing to help me.

My new vet did suggest to give my dog a Benadryl pill each morning with food and wash all her bedding.

Since I did so my dog's cough has lessened each day.
Doctors are attentive and thorough. They take time to explain what and why they are doing what they do. When there are alternatives they explain them. The environment is inviting and relaxed.
The clinic was very calm and clean. No chaos. A stark difference from our previous vet.

They were there exactly when I needed them . My new kitten was having seizures ,not eating or drinking, high fever
They gave me the new client rate even though I was a walk in and after 3 days my kitten is eating and getti ng better !

The Dr. Is very gental and explains things very well. She knows my little Shannon is not fond on visiting the vets so she talks very gentle to her . I am also a nervous mom and the Dr.s cheerful manner puts me at ease as well. The staff is also very kind. One time we had to go on her birthday and the staff made her a hat and gave her a birthday ribbon.  We still have the hat  and ribbon and  cherish that memory.  Thanks for taking care of our sweetie pie.

Getting an appointment and helping us out!

I have tookin our franchise dog to them on 3-4 occassions.
Each time on the phone before we went there and our entire experience (dog and myself) we were able to remain calm comfortable in fact had a very pleasant experience. Communications were excellent between them and the dog and with me as well.
The actual vet actually called over the weekend to ask how the dog was doing. It was comforting to know they really cared how our dog was healing and doing.  They made clear if we had any questions or concerns to feel free to call them. Overall it was very pleasant the staff was very nice and the place was very clean and the purpose of our visits were always addressed and tookin care of.  Even better the prices were reasonable if not very good. I'm very happy with the vets here and will be returning as necessary when necessary. I rate them 5 star and definitely recommend them to anyone who needs to see a vet or is looking for a vet who competent and not money hungry. Thanks

I took my cat, Steel, to Kearny Mesa Veterinary Center for an injury. The staff were very welcoming and thorough.  After X-rays determined my cat had a serious fracture, the doctor provided the information for a surgical consultation along with additional resource information that could help facilitate recovery for my cat.  It was a great experience aside from the diagnosis.  Its nice to have a place to take your pet that seems to care as much as you do about your fur-baby's health and well-being.  Thank you so much!!

I highly recommend Kearney Mesa Veterinary Center. I moved to Clairemont 6 years ago and this is by far the best vet clinic in the area. Dr Martinez Diaz and the staff are super compassionate and knowledgeable.The quality of care evident! Easy to schedule and fairly priced, I will continue to bring my pets here!! Truly the best in the area!

They were able to get me an appointment the same day for my dog Cozmo who has an infection. Staff was very nice and receptive. Dr Maria Diaz was great and listened to the issues of my aging dog. Start him on antibiotics, and we will return to complete the necessary procedures.

Dr. Diego Espinosa was incredible in assisting us with our ill cat. He was empathetic, understanding, and had extensive knowledge about the disease my cat was suffering from. He provided us with excellent guidance on the treatment. The entire team really helped us through the process. We truly appreciate your help with our cat!

Dr Martinez and the entire staff at Kearny Mesa Vet were absolutely amazing. They took the best care of our sick corgi.

We had an appointment for the afternoon but due to symptoms worsening they had him do a drop off exam and ensured he was taken care is the whole time. Our baby boy is back to himself!! We can’t thank Dr Martinez and her team enough!

WARNING. They over charge for everything. They force you to get an exam every time even for a follow-up visit for the same issue (which other vet offices DO NOT do, I called around and asked)

An EAR “exam” costs $60 at nearby vets… this place charges $90.
Medication my dog needed was $65 online and at another nearby vet - Kearny Mesa Veterinary Care charges $90 for it. They told me my follow up visit would only be $90 and even gave me a paper print out with my follow-up exam quote - then after arriving for the visit said they wanted to do another “full exam” that my dog JUST got 2 months ago. Plus a $90 ear exam again (costing close to $300.) All for a simple ear infection.

Their exam fee is also high. My advice: wait and go somewhere else. Don’t go here just because they have availability. There’s a reason they’re so available. Don’t buy any of their ear cleaning and probably any other product they sell either. It is VERY marked up in price. I compared the ear cleaner they wanted me to buy there for around $50 - and found it on Amazon for $24.99 with free one day shipping.

They care more about making money than treating your animal. 0 stars. Will never bring any of my animals here again.

Oh also I called and asked for a refill because my dog’s ear drops ran out - they never returned my call. But they had no problem calling me 5 times to collect a payment I owed. Unreliable and a rip off.

Thank you for the rating, C. We're disappointed to see you didn't have the best experience with us. If you have additional feedback or concerns feel free to contact us at (858) 279-3000. We hope, if ever needed, you visit us again for a better experience.
Very friendly and understanding. I had a heart warming experience when I showed up for an appointment in error.

I needed to take my pet Kai, an English + French bull dog, a handsome hunk, 39 lbs, for a required updated vaccine ASAP and last Monday 03/03/2025 afternoon, by browsing online, happened to browse online and saw Kearny Mesa Veterinarian Center time available the next morning 9:30am, so I booked it and immediately received a phone call confirmation from them. The visit was soooooo pleasant and enjoyable which escaped my mind that it was a new place since all young and beautiful ladies: Kiilie, Sarah, & Maddy in the office were very kind, friendly, welcoming us in a professional manner. This did really make Kai feeling very comfortable walking in fearlessly.
*** Dr. Martinez and her assistant Cambryn were soooo good with KAI through the vaccines.
*** In summary, the experience was wonderful and will keep in mind for all future visits, especially it was my very first time taking Kai out alone without my 45-year-old son, Jonathan.
🙏 Thank you all very much for an excellent service, for an outstanding teamwork as it was an unforgettable experience.

A wonderful place for my pets. The staff are trustworthy and provide great care.
I always feel confident leaving loved ones in their care.
Thank you for taking care of Aspen we appreciate you!
Dr. Diego was great and catered to all our needs and answered all questions honestly. Will definitely be back
The vet tech was exceptionally communicative and kind. Answered all my questions patiently and respectfully. The Dr. was great as well with comprehensive care and patient with my questions.

Only been coming since April. Unfortunately had to come a lot for my senior dog that’s now 16, but everything is okay after every visit with Dr. Martinez. She’s really awesome and very good with my little Lucy. Pricing is a bit up there comparative to other places but the quality of care I have received here is worth it. The parking is reasonable and if you are military affiliated, active or veteran they do take a percentage off your visit which helps. I highly recommend coming here :)
Very professional outfit.  I felt certain that my pet was in the right hands.  The fact that he was ill at all was traumatic.  Knowing he was in the best possible hands made it relatively better.
Dr Nova was awesome and explained everything very well.

This has been a really scary process with him being in and out of the emergency vet for multiple nights at a time and it brings me a lot of comfort that the team here is always very open to getting questions and giving advice over the phone. Thanks guys.

I typically do not write Yelp reviews; however, I feel compelled to share my experience with Dr. Martinez following my visit with my cat. …
